note: Ozark hardwood forest north of Bland, crossed by gravel roads and multi-use trails. There are two primitive camping areas about 2.4 km apart with separate entrances. The north one is by the large gravel lot on Bock Road (off Boettcher Road), and the south one is a gravel spur off the area road that runs in from Route A. No amenities; spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - two mapped Primitive Camping areas (north at the Bock Road lot = pin area, south 2.4 km away on its own access road from Route A); free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. South area proposed as a split. Pin is the GIS point ~155 m into the woods west of the north lot; move to the lot suggested. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'. The brochure (02/2024) says: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites. No amenities are provided. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply.' The 10/16/2023 map shows two Primitive Camping symbols, one beside the parking lot on Bock Road and one beside the southern lot on the area road from Route A. GIS layer 27 has both (332, 151). On imagery the north lot (298) is a large gravel lot, ~25 x 75 m, at the road, and the south point sits on a gravel pad/spur, ~15 x 60 m, off the gravel area road. A 23-ft rig fits both. Gravel roads, with no ford, 4WD note or posted limit.

SPLIT PROPOSED: south camping area, GIS 151 at 38.32152,-91.60928 (lot 301 at 38.3231,-91.60898 is ~180 m north on the same road). It's 2.43 km from the pin and on a separate entrance: the area page directs 'Route A north about 1.20 miles, then east on the area's southern most access road (the road north of Rehmert Road)', while the north camp is reached by 'Boettcher Road 1.5 miles' and Bock Road. Suggested entry: 'Canaan Conservation Area - South Camping Area' at ~38.3216,-91.6093, not waterfront, same MDC groups and phone.

PIN: stored 38.34144,-91.59788 = GIS camping point 332. On the leaf-off frame it sits inside the woods at the south edge of a field, ~155 m west of gravel lot 298 (38.34145,-91.59608), with no track visible to it. The map puts the camping symbol just west of that lot. Suggest moving the pin to the lot (38.3414,-91.5961), where a rig would actually park.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): only small creeks (Clear Fork, Sulphur Branch) and wildlife water holes.
PHONE: (573) 897-3797 on the area page matches.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. The brochure says 'Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply', with no dates.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, acreage, the 14-day line and the directions dropped; the two camping areas described.
